name: Overclock
author: Paycei
description: New content for wave mode: Bouncers ricochet around the arena from wave 3 on, PULSE_CORE.exe (a 3-level power-up) shocks every enemy near you, and OVERCLOCK, a two-phase boss with a scripted bullet ring and dash, replaces the wave 10 boss. Shows register.enemy, roster.add, register.powerup, register.boss and bossForWave.
